pack-land: A thick old book set down on a wooden desk: a soft leathery thump with a little paper rustle. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
pack-hover: A light brush of fingertips across old parchment, a tiny papery whisper. Very short. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
tear-scrub: Continuous slow tearing of heavy parchment paper by hand, fibrous crackling rip, steady and loopable. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
tear: A quick tear of a sealed parchment envelope ripped open by hand, crisp fibrous paper rip ending with a soft wax seal crack. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
pack-burst: An old book flung open: a flurry of pages fanning and fluttering, then a soft tinkling music box flourish, gentle storybook reveal.
cards-slide: A small stack of thick paper cards sliding across a leather desk blotter, smooth and soft, ending in a gentle stop. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
deal: A single thick paper card laid down quickly on a leather desk, a short soft papery slap. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
flip: A single page of an old book turned quickly, a short crisp papery flick. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
uncommon: A single soft music box note, delicate and clear, short with a gentle tail.
rare: A short delicate music box phrase of three rising notes, sweet and clear, a pleasant discovery.
mythic: A gentle music box melody rising in a short sparkling arpeggio with a soft warm string pad swelling underneath, storybook wonder, calm and not loud. No drums.
select: A quill pen tapping once on parchment, a soft small dry tick. Very short. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
deselect: A softer, duller papery tick, a fingertip lifting off a page. Very short. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
pick: A card tucked between the pages of a book and the heavy book closed: a soft papery slide and a satisfying leathery thump. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
burn: A sheet of parchment catching fire: a quick papery crackle and a soft flame whoosh, short.
pack-arrive: A thick book slid across a wooden desk toward you, stopping with a soft leathery bump. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
pack-pass: A thick book pushed away across a wooden desk, a short soft slide. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
tick: A single loud clear tick of an old mantel clock, crisp and wooden with a short click. Close-up, dry, no music.
tap: A paper card rotated on a leather desk, a soft brushing turn and tap. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
zoom-open: A page lifted up close to read: a soft paper lift with a gentle breath of air. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
zoom-close: A page lowered back onto a book: a soft papery settle. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
row-hover: An extremely quiet tiny paper tick, a fingertip grazing the edge of a page, barely audible and very short. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
turn-over: A heavy page turned over in an old book: a slow crisp paper sweep and soft settle. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
